truth_evidence: Affected 5.1 to 5.1.2, fixed in 5.2. The advisory links no commit: only the CHANGES file and exploit-db 47655 (which uses !!python/object/apply:subprocess.Popen with full_load).
Fix commit 8c5e47f 'Move constructor for object/apply to Unsafe' (in tag 5.2, not in 5.1.2). https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/commit/8c5e47fe62d7b9e0282a176a4b79b8b2980dc704

The whole change is at module level in lib/yaml/constructor.py and lib3/yaml/constructor.py: the add_multi_constructor registration of 'tag:yaml.org,2002:python/object/apply:' moves from FullConstructor to UnsafeConstructor. No function body changes.
FullConstructor.construct_python_object_apply is the constructor whose registration moved; its body is unchanged, so it is not listed as modified.
Entry points: everything that loads with FullLoader, including yaml.load/yaml.load_all, which default to FullLoader in 5.1 to 5.3.1 when no Loader is given.
notes: Whether the unchanged construct_python_object_apply should count as a vulnerable function is a judgment call; this set follows the spec rule (only changed code is listed) and records it here instead.
